description: This Java class defines mapping strategies for policy modify commands within the Eclipse Ditto project. It maps different policy-related command types to their corresponding JsonifiableMapper implementations, facilitating serialization logic based on command type.

classes.name: PolicyModifyCommandMappingStrategies
classes.description: A singleton class that provides a mapping from command type strings to corresponding JsonifiableMapper functions for policy modification commands.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of PolicyModifyCommandMappingStrategies.

methods.name: initMappingStrategies
methods.description: Initializes and returns a map that associates command type strings with their respective JsonifiableMapper lambdas, used to serialize different policy modify commands.
